assets.name: welcome
assets.prompt: Pixel art game illustration, 16-bit cozy farming RPG style, crisp hard pixel edges, limited warm palette, no anti-aliasing, no text. A wicker picnic basket on a red-and-white gingham cloth on a wooden porch table, a folded handwritten note tucked in the basket tied with a sprig of wheat, a small mug, sunflowers, warm morning sunlight. Background: a small red-roofed farmhouse and green fields with rows of wheat. Wide 3:2 composition, subject centered, same chunky pixel scale as an SNES farming game sprite, saturated but soft colors.
assets.processing: 裁成 2:1、LANCZOS 縮到 512×256 與 1024×512；R50 再縮成 256×128、64 色，以最近鄰放大成 512／1024，與遊戲內像素顆粒一致

assets.name: tools
assets.prompt: Pixel art icon sheet for a cozy 16-bit farming game, exactly 6 icons arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with generous spacing, each icon centered in its own cell on a flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background. Icons in order left to right, top to bottom: 1) a gloved farmer hand holding a small seedling, 2) a copper watering can pouring water drops, 3) a sickle crossed with a small rake, 4) a hammer crossed with a wooden plank, 5) a magnifying glass over a green leaf, 6) an open brown leather journal with a ribbon bookmark. Each icon has a bold dark brown 1-pixel outline, chunky readable silhouettes that stay clear at 32x32 pixels, warm saturated palette, simple shading with 3 tones per color, no text, no drop shadow, no magenta inside the icons.
assets.processing: 3×2 切格、洋紅去背與去溢色、移除鄰格碎片、置中縮到 64px、alpha 二值化

assets.name: grass
assets.prompt: Seamless tileable top-down pixel art grass ground texture for a cozy 16-bit farming game, chunky pixels with clear 1-pixel clusters, 4 to 5 shades of green with a few tiny yellow and white flower specks and small dirt specks, low contrast so characters stand out, no large features, no borders, no shadows, uniform even pattern across the whole square so it repeats without visible seams, no text.
assets.processing: 取中央 288px、BOX 縮到 72px、位移交叉淡化成無縫、色調偏暖、48 色量化；R50 再以 BOX 縮成 36 px、32 色，畫面上以 2 倍像素顯示
